summary: This bill amends the Museum and Library Services Act to authorize grants for institutions of higher education to create and use free, publicly available digital resources for required reading assignments in science, technology, engineering, and math courses, prioritizing institutions with high numbers of low-income or minority students.

scores.thoughts: This bill authorizes grants to institutions of higher education to promote the use of free, publicly available digital resources for required reading assignments, specifically in STEM courses. This initiative aims to reduce costs for students and increase access to educational materials, which directly supports public education by making it more affordable and accessible.
